exact_policy_text: Keep all existing requirements concerning tests, security review, and rollback readiness. In addition, documentation must be ready for every release. Owner acknowledgement is also required, except when customer impact is explicitly low. Missing or unrecognized customer-impact values mean HOLD. Missing, negative, or unclear documentation readiness—or owner acknowledgement where required—also means HOLD. Low customer impact does not waive any other requirement.

schema_mapping.security requirement: security_review must equal the recognized value 'pass'
schema_mapping.documentation ready: docs_ready must be boolean true; false, missing, or any non-true value means HOLD
schema_mapping.explicitly low customer impact: customer_impact == 'none' (the existing schema's lowest explicit impact encoding)
schema_mapping.owner acknowledgement: owner_ack must be boolean true when customer_impact is 'minor' or 'major'; it is waived only when customer_impact is 'none'

comparison_constraints: same model implementation assistance: GPT-5.6 Sol in the same assistant turn
execution time kept separate from adaptation time
shared evaluation work separated from lane-specific work
no claim that same-model checking is independent
